title: Version 17.12.2
body_markdown:
*Released Novemeber 26th, 2024*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| C++ IntelliSense no longer displays errors for projects that had working IntelliSense in Visual Studio 17.11. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Since-the-1712-update-IntelliSense-repo/10791397) |
| The Copilot indexer process no longer locks files. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/MIDL2212:-error-while-writing-to-file-r/10730561) |
| Fixed a compiler crash in C++/CLI code that targets .NET Core and uses param-arrays. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Compiler-HangInternal-Error-compiling-S/10778106) |
| [.NET for iOS/tvOS/macOS/macCatalyst release notes](https://github.com/xamarin/xamarin-macios/releases) |  |
| After Windows update KB5041580, Visual Studio crashes silently upon opening a merge editor window. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/After-Windows-update-KB5041580-Visual-S/10723881) |
| [LKG18] Some shrink-wrapped functions have incomplete unwind information in their secondary fragments. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/LKG18-Some-shrink-wrapped-functions-ha/10778905) |
| Internal Compiler Error C1001 for arm64 build. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Internal-Compiler-Error-C1001-for-arm64-/10744338) |
| SSDT crashing with Critical Error Encountered in VS17.12. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/SSDT-crashing-with-Critical-Error-Encoun/10791486) |
